response.sql: WITH driver_totals AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(laps, '\N'), '') AS REAL)) AS average_laps FROM results WHERE grid >= 12 GROUP BY driverId) SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_points_total, AVG(average_laps) AS average_of_average_laps FROM driver_totals
